newsitem.title: USA: PICO unit sells Resource stake.
newsitem.headline: PICO unit sells Resource stake.

text.p: Resource America Inc said on Monday that Physicians Insurance Co of Ohio exercised its warrants on unregistered 983,150 Resource shares, which were sold in a private placement to institutional investors.
Physicians Insurance is a wholly owned subsidiary of PICO Holdings Inc. No further financial details of the transaction were provided.
Resource said in a news release that John Hart, president of PICO Holdings, resigned from Resource's board due to the sale of PICO's Resource shares.
In a separate private placement, Resource said it sold $115 million in senior notes due 2007 to a group of institutional investors, and also paid off an $8 million promissory note held by PICO.
The promissory note was due in 2004.
Resource America is a finance company specializing in real estate mortgages and equipment lease finance. The company also owns and operates some energy assets in the Appalachian Basin.
